claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
The older mechanic is weathered, gray-stubbled, and wears oil-stained dark coveralls.
The younger mechanic wears a faded blue work shirt and carries a wrench.
The engine is an exposed inline block with a frayed drive belt, set among tool trays, coiled hoses, and a cluttered workbench.
The soundtrack is a low garage hum with irregular metallic ticks and small tool clinks, with no music.

subjects.description: An older mechanic with weathered features, gray stubble, oil-stained dark coveralls, and a set jaw.
A younger mechanic with short hair, a faded blue work shirt, and a wrench held in one hand.
An exposed inline engine on a stand, its frayed drive belt visible against the dark block.
A narrow garage bay crowded with a workbench, tool trays, coiled hoses, and oil-stained concrete.
